purpose: INCART integrity audit and V4 split preparation; no beat extraction or training

annotation_alignment_screen.method: lead II local max absolute excursion from +/-250 ms median within +/-100 ms
annotation_alignment_screen.warning: Screening only; do not shift annotations globally without morphology-stratified review.

proposed_split.search: 100000 fixed-seed patient permutations; count balance only; no waveforms/model outputs

v4_contract.other_policy: exclude; never map OTHER to NORMAL
v4_contract.incart_resampling: 257 Hz to 250 Hz with scipy.signal.resample_poly(up=250, down=257)
v4_contract.annotation_mapping: round half up: floor(sample*250/257 + 0.5); validate on extracted windows
v4_contract.window: 256 samples centered at mapped annotation: 128 before, 128 from center
v4_contract.normalization: per-window z-score with finite/epsilon guard, matching V1
v4_contract.test_policy: seal proposed INCART test patients; no architecture, checkpoint, or threshold selection
